hypotheses.text: Across postnatally evaluated patients harboring pathogenic biallelic PLAA variants in published cohorts (including Hall 2017, Chitre 2018, and Han 2025), thinning or hypoplasia of the corpus callosum (HP:0002079) is present in >90% of individuals who undergo brain MRI after the neonatal period, demonstrating progressive secondary callosal atrophy rather than classic primary callosal agenesis.
hypotheses.rationale: Neuroimaging patterns differentiate PLAA-related disorder from static encephalopathies and primary callosal dysgenesis. Determining the exact pooled frequency and structural nature of callosal anomalies across published cohorts clarifies whether corpus callosum hypoplasia is an obligate diagnostic criterion.

evidence.text: In the index PLAA discovery cohort, neuroimaging in the first year of life demonstrated a thin corpus callosum, delayed myelination, and cerebral atrophy.

hypotheses.text: Progressive cerebral atrophy (HP:0002059) displays a significantly higher penetrance on serial neuroimaging than cerebellar vermis/hemispheric atrophy (HP:0001272) in PLAA deficiency, with cerebellar atrophy manifesting later in the disease course (>12 months of age).
hypotheses.rationale: While both cerebral and cerebellar volume loss are cataloged as core features of PLAA-related disorder, establishing the temporal onset and penetrance of infratentorial versus supratentorial atrophy is critical to distinguish PLAA from primary pontocerebellar hypoplasias (PCH) and PEHO-like mimics.

hypotheses.text: Serial MRI in PLAA-associated neurodevelopmental disorder distinguishes it from classical ZNHIT3-associated Finnish PEHO syndrome by demonstrating an initially preserved cerebellum in neonates rather than congenital cerebellar hypoplasia at birth.
hypotheses.rationale: PEHO and PEHO-like syndromes share optic atrophy, hypsarrhythmia, and progressive microcephaly. Differentiating whether cerebellar volume loss is congenital hypoplasia or late-onset degenerative atrophy informs differential diagnosis before genetic confirmation.

new_directions.question_text: What are the exact patient-by-patient MRI findings (corpus callosum thickness, cerebral atrophy stage, myelination status) across the Falik Zaccai (2017) cohort to complete the unified numerator/denominator database?
new_directions.rationale: Directly compiling the individual MRI rows from Falik Zaccai et al. alongside Hall 2017, Chitre 2018, and Han 2025 will establish a definitive pooled neuroimaging numerator and denominator.

new_directions.question_text: At what median postnatal age does cerebellar atrophy (HP:0001272) become detectable by MRI in PLAA patients compared to cerebral atrophy (HP:0002059)?
new_directions.rationale: Determining the chronological order of cerebral versus cerebellar atrophy on serial scans establishes an objective timeline to distinguish PLAA from infantile neuroaxonal dystrophy (PLAN/PLA2G6) and pontocerebellar hypoplasias.
